text.text_excerpt: This is my new favorite beer spot in the city by far. I was worried about it being too touristy because of its location but it's far from that. I enjoyed the venue as well as the selection of beers and cocktails. I'm always all for outdoor seating and although it is all inclosed it has the feel out the outdoors. They had the doors opened also as the weather that evening was perfect for it. One thing I really enjoyed about the place, aside from the picnic style tables, were the various games at the table. It had been awhile since I've seen a deck of UNO cards and I was excited to play with them. That was a huge bonus! I was a bit confused at first about the two bars offering different thin...

Me and my friends had a great time. We came here for crawfish friday a couple of weeks back and although the service a little slow and the waitress wasn't sure of the HH specials, my experience here was still fantastic. We had about 20 of us and there was enough space for us all with there huge picnic style tables. The crawfish was spicy and good size. They had a few beers on tap which were $5 for happy hour. Also there were $4 house wines and 1/2 off bottles of wine. There is shuffle board and ping pong and a giant sized jenga to play as well as table games. It's a really fun atmosphere and even though you are inside, you feel like you are outside. I really like this place for being so a...

I didn't give 5 stars due to the small beer selection. They had some craft and local brews I hadn't had previously which is a big plus, but they only had 6 beers on tap and were out of one of them. With that said, this is a very cute beer joint tucked away in the Warehouse District. The decorations are made to look like you're in an outside patio and the atmosphere is open and inviting. Plenty of room for large groups and it seems like the people who go here don't get crazy like the bars closer to the French Quarter.
